benefits.text: A versatile brow pencil that helps you draw hair-like strokes easily. Create your own signature look by defining your brows to bring out your overall features. Draw individual brow hairs with hince's sharp pencil tip to complete a refined brow makeup look.

howToUse.text: Draw your brows in the shape you want.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.
